title: His tent show
summary: Laine briefly describes his tent show as a vaudeville outfit with singing, dancing and tricks.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Dick, can you think of anything? Yeah, sure. Papa? What about your tent show? Didn't you have your own tent show at one time? Yes. What kind of show was it?
Regular Vortival outfits. What did they do? Sing, dance, do tricks, stuff like that. Regular Vortival.
